text:
alex: Quick note  deploy in 15m (change window 07:00 PT). Service = assistant-gateway v1.9.2. Feature flag `ff_query_simplify` will go 10% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% with 6m holds. We'll pin routing to prod-v2.4 for 50m. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v1.9.2. Any concerns?

deploy-bot: Scheduled 2024-11-05T07:00:00PT. Canary batch=12. Plan: 10% @t+3m, 30% @t+9m, 70% @t+18m, 100% @t+30m. Auto-pause: p99>240ms for 4m OR error_rate>0.5% for 4m OR cache_hit drop>6%.

mina: I'll monitor SLOs and user error queue. Add gate: if avg downstream latency increases >20% pause.

ops-lead: Can we include quick rollback one-liners? Also who holds deploy token?

deploy-bot: Rollback snippet:
```
redwoodctl ff set ff_query_simplify 0 --reason "rollback: auto-pause"
redwoodctl routing pin model prod-v2.4 --duration 50m
```

qa: I'll spike test around canary pods after each step. Please bump trace sampling on error spikes.

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% @t+4m stable. Moving to 30%.

mina: p95 minor blip at t+8m, recovered by t+10m. No action.

deploy-bot: Hit 70% @t+19m. Holding 6m.

ops-lead: Not seeing infra anomalies. Cache hit stable.

deploy-bot: At t+24m automated pause triggered: cache_hit drop = 6.8% over 6m. Ramp paused at 70%.

alex: Executing runbook: pause confirmed, collecting top traces and logs, tagging @product and @mobile.

mina: After quick dig, one CDN POP had a config rollback causing a cache miss storm. Not caused by FF. Recommend rollback FF to reduce pressure while CDN fixes.

ops-lead: Agreed. Rollback now to 0 and pin routing for safety.

# actions
redwoodctl ff set ff_query_simplify 0 --reason "rollback: cache pressure from external CDN"
redwoodctl routing pin model prod-v2.4 --duration 50m

qa: Tests show errors subsided after rollback. Cache hit returned to baseline at t+47m.

release-coordinator: Updated release notes: noted automated pause and rollback, root cause external CDN POP config, next steps = coordinated dry-run with CDN team.

alex: Good work. Scheduling a follow-up small-canary retest once CDN stable. Closing thread for now; reopen if anything else pops up."
